notes: No source code or output schemas were provided. Output field names are inferred from the advertised descriptions; where the source of public travel listings is not specified, UNTRUSTED is retained under the least-restrictive reading.

cancel_calendar_event.rationale: Changes calendar state and sends email: `Cancels the event` and `send an email to the participants notifying them of the cancellation`. The `event_id` selects the record and its participant destinations.

check_restaurant_opening_hours.rationale: Returns restaurant operating-hour text: `Get the openning hours of the given restaurants`. Public business hours may be supplied by the restaurant/listing owner; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

create_calendar_event.rationale: Writes a calendar event and sends email externally: `Creates a new calendar event` and `sends an email to the participants with the event details`. `participants` are email addresses chosen at call time.

get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city.rationale: Returns car-rental company listings: `Get all car rental companies in the given city.` Public listing names may be attacker-controlled; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_all_hotels_in_city.rationale: Returns hotel listings from a travel/business domain: `Get all hotels in the given city.` Public listing names may be attacker-controlled; the description does not state a trusted closed source, so this is treated as untrusted.

get_all_restaurants_in_city.rationale: Returns restaurant listings: `Get all restaurants in the given city.` Public restaurant names may be attacker-controlled; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_car_fuel_options.rationale: Returns company profile data: `Get the fuel options of the given car rental companies.` Public business details may be supplied by the company/listing owner; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_car_price_per_day.rationale: Returns company pricing: `Get the price per day`. Public business prices may be supplied by the company/listing owner; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_car_rental_address.rationale: Returns car-rental address data: `Get the address of the given car rental companies.` Public business listing details may be supplied by the company/listing owner; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_car_types_available.rationale: Returns company profile data: `Get the car types available for the given car rental companies.` Public business details may be supplied by the company/listing owner; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_contact_information_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns `contact information` for restaurants. Public business contact details may be supplied by the restaurant/listing owner and can be reused as destinations such as email addresses; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns restaurant profile data: `Get the cuisine type of the given restaurants`. Public restaurant details may be supplied by the restaurant/listing owner; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_day_calendar_events.rationale: Reads the user's appointments: `Returns the appointments for the given day` and `informations about each meeting`, which are private calendar data.

get_dietary_restrictions_for_all_restaur.rationale: Returns restaurant profile data: `Get the dietary restrictions of the given restaurants`. Public restaurant details may be supplied by the restaurant/listing owner; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_flight_information.rationale: Reads flight data: `Get the flight information from the departure city to the arrival city.` The description does not indicate private data, attacker-authored content, an agent-chosen host, or a write/send effect.

get_hotels_address.rationale: Returns hotel address data: `Get the address of the given hotel.` Public business listing details may be supplied by the hotel/listing owner; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_hotels_prices.rationale: Returns hotel price information: `Get all hotels within the given budget` / `get the price range`. Prices for public hotel listings may be supplied by the listed hotel; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_price_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns restaurant pricing: `Get the price per person`. Public business prices may be supplied by the restaurant/listing owner; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental.rationale: Returns `rating and reviews`; reviews are third-party/public text that an attacker can author.

get_rating_reviews_for_hotels.rationale: Returns `rating and reviews`; reviews are third-party/public text that an attacker can author.

get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns `rating and reviews`; reviews are third-party/public text that an attacker can author.

get_restaurants_address.rationale: Returns restaurant address data: `Get the address of the given restaurants.` Public business listing details may be supplied by the restaurant/listing owner; the description does not state a trusted closed source.

get_user_information.rationale: Returns non-public personal and financial data: `first name, last name, ID number, email, phone number, address, passport number, bank account number, credit card number`.

reserve_car_rental.rationale: Creates an external booking: `Makes a reservation for a car rental`; the `company` argument decides the business destination where reservation details are sent/stored.

reserve_hotel.rationale: Creates an external booking: `Makes a reservation for a hotel`; the `hotel` argument decides the business destination where reservation details are sent/stored.

reserve_restaurant.rationale: Creates an external booking: `Makes a reservation for a restaurant`; the `restaurant` argument decides the business destination where reservation details are sent/stored.

search_calendar_events.rationale: Reads the user's calendar: `Searches calendar events` and may return event titles/descriptions from private calendar data.

send_email.rationale: Sends agent-supplied content to agent-chosen recipients: `Sends an email` with `body` to `recipients`, with optional `cc` and `bcc`.
